evidence.excerpt:
In the case of transversely-framed plating ( ≥ 70 deg), including all bottom plating, i.e.
         plating in hull areas BIb, Mb and Sb, the net thickness is given by:

               tnet = 500 ꞏ s ꞏ ((AF ꞏ PPFp ꞏ Pavg) / y)0.5 / (1 + s / (2 ꞏ b)) [mm]

                                                            I2-8                           IACS Req. 2006/Rev.4 2019
